* Each line following this comment block contains data for one mapping point.
* Column 1 is the label of the roving trace from which the data were collected.
* Column 2 is a space-separated list of the catheter electrodes making up that signal (1=D).
* Column 3 is a space-separated list of the hardware channels (1-128) making up that signal.
* Column 4 is the ID of the acquisition group of that data (a single freeze-save).
* Column 5 is the ID of the specific point (as shown in the Velocity GUI).
* Column 6 is the label of the reference trace (used to compare with the roving trace).
* Column 7 is the label of the second reference trace (Ref2).
* Columns 8-10 are the xyz coordinates of the roving electrode (including any Field Scaling or Fusion).
* Columns 11-13 are the xyz coordinates of the roving electrode when projected onto the surface model.
* Columns 14-16 are the unit surface normal vector of the projected point (outward-facing).
* Column 17 is a flag for whether this point was Displayed on the map (i.e. its visibility checkbox in the wave panel was not turned off by the user).

* Column 18 is a flag for whether this point was Utilized in computing the map (i.e. it's Displayed; it's not a duplicate of nearby points; and it's within the Interior and Exterior projection distances).
* Column 19 is a code for whether this point was Gold-Starred by the user (a duplicate of a nearby point(s) that the user clicked to set as the primary point that hides the other duplicates).
* Column 20 is the peak-to-peak voltage of the roving trace (in mV)..
* Column 21 is 1 if the the peak-to-peak voltage of the roving trace (in mV). value is valid; 0 if not.

* Column 22 is refTime (the time at which activation was detected on the reference channel; or the center of the mapping interval for non-cardiac-triggered maps).  The units are seconds since 1 Jan 1970.
* Column 23 is any manual adjustment that was made to refTime by the user (in msec).  If nonzero the original reference detection was at refTime - adjTime.
* Column 24 is the time of the left curtain (in msec relative to the refTime).
* Column 25 is the time of the right curtain (in msec relative to the refTime).
* Column 26 is the force on the acquisition catheter's distal electrode in g (or 'invalid' if force data not available).
* Column 27 is the activation sequence metric (ref2 - ref) in ms.
* Column 28 is the user-input annotation string for this point (if any).
* Column 29 is the number of additional parameters N we are exporting (for future extensibility).
* The next N columns are those parameters:

%2* The next column is the sample number corresponding to refTime (this sample number matches a particular timepoint in the Wave_ref.csv file created when the user chooses Include Waveform Data in the Data Export dialog box).
* The next column is the number of tick marks (activation detections) on the roving wave.
* The remaining columns are the sample number(s) at which activation was detected on the roving wave (matches a particular timepoint in the Wave_rov.csv file).
* The next N columns are those parameters.
